reports.title: Household Registration Population Statistics (戶籍登記人口統計)
reports.publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Household Registration (內政部戶政司)
reports.description: Continuously-updated administrative population register maintained by MOI's Department of Household Registration (births, deaths, migration, household composition, population by area), distinct from the decennial Population and Housing Census; the primary administrative data source underlying most day-to-day Taiwan demographic statistics.

dependencies.basis: MOEA's own introduction page for the Export Orders Survey states that the survey's sampling population is constructed directly from the prior year's customs export data files.

The same MOEA introduction page states the survey population also draws on triangular-trade enterprises identified in the Industrial and Service Census, Taiwan's establishment/business demography survey system.

A DGBAS 'Accounting and Statistics Monthly' article by MOEA Dept. of Statistics officials states the electronics industry analysis (including this sub-category) combines MOEA's Industrial Production Statistics data as a core input.
The same article states the electronics-industry analysis is built on DGBAS's Industrial and Service Census results.
Same DGBAS bulletin article: 'Computers, Electronic & Optical Products' is one of its named industry breakdowns, combining MOEA Industrial Production Statistics data.
Same article: this electronics/computers analysis is built on DGBAS Industrial and Service Census results.
Same article's semiconductor supply-chain breakdown (IC design, foundry, packaging/testing) combines MOEA Industrial Production Statistics data.
Same article: the semiconductor industry-structure analysis is built on DGBAS's Industrial and Service Census results.

MND's own FY114 budget-preparation summary states DGBAS requested MND's mid-range fiscal expenditure needs and the Executive Yuan (via DGBAS's coordination) approved MND's FY114-117 budget ceiling — the defense budget is prepared within DGBAS's central budget-ceiling framework.

DGBAS's own page on the FY115 central government general budget expresses the defense budget as a share of GDP, meaning the standard defense-to-GDP metric uses DGBAS's national accounts (GDP) as denominator.

MAC's Cross-Strait Economic Statistics Monthly table on Taiwan investment to mainland China carries a source note stating the Taiwan-side figures are compiled from the Investment Commission (Department of Investment Review), MOEA. Independently corroborated by Grok's separately-run round-2 prompt citing the same PDF and near-identical quote.
The same MAC monthly report's table on mainland Chinese investment approved into Taiwan carries an explicit source note naming the Investment Commission's statistics as origin.
The same MAC monthly report's regional breakdown of approved Taiwan investment in mainland China cites the same Investment Commission statistics as source.

MAC's Cross-Strait Key Economic Indicators Statistical Flash Report lists the cross-strait trade row with explicit attribution to the Ministry of Finance's Statistics Department (Taiwan's official customs-based trade statistics).

The 2021 National Hakka Population and Language Survey report (Hakka Affairs Council) states it used MOI household-registration population counts by township/district as of Dec 2020 as the population base for post-stratification weighting.
The Council of Indigenous Peoples' own monthly indigenous population statistics page states the figures are based on data published by MOI's household registration office.
The county/city breakdown of indigenous population figures is published on the same CIP statistics page, which states the underlying figures are drawn from MOI household-registration data.
NDC's official announcement of the 2024-2070 population projection states the projection is updated every two years based on the latest household registration population data.

MOI's internal-statistics bulletin on births/fertility rate states the figures are compiled by occurrence date as recorded in household registration, footnote naming the Household Registration Office as the data source.
MOI's index of immigration-related statistics states foreign/mainland-spouse resident figures prior to Nov 2015 were sourced from the Household Registration Office's population database.

The official DGBAS statistics portal lists internal/international migration series titles that explicitly designate them as household-registration-based figures, jointly attributed to MOI's Department of Household Registration and DGBAS.
The same Central Bank paper explains the International Investment Position, whose liabilities side underlies external-debt statistics, is presented under BPM6.
Cross-strait trade share is published within MAC's Cross-Strait Economic Statistics Monthly bulletin.
National science-park revenue aggregate uses Hsinchu Science Park bureau reporting.
Science park geography page cites the national science-parks system it belongs to.
Semiconductor industry stats draw on Hsinchu park tenant/output data.
AI demand concentration analysis cites Hsinchu park sales/tenant records driven by AI/HPC demand.
National R&D statistics compile science-park R&D expenditure/personnel figures.
Indigenous population geography breakdown is calculated from the indigenous population count.
Industrial water for semiconductor sector figures draw on national water resources agency data.
Industrial water report cites the science parks system whose water demand it discusses.

The mnd.gov.tw half of this was never a real block — plain curl reads the whole domain; the 'ROBOTS_DISALLOWED' verdict was WebFetch obeying robots.txt. On re-reading, the National Defense Report's mobilisation chapter mentions civil defense only as an exercise participant and as 可用民力 inside the All-out Defense Mobilization Integrated Information System — too vague to carry a dependency on the registration/training series this node names. Separately, aodm.mnd.gov.tw (the All-Out Defense Mobilization Agency's own site) is unreachable from both the cloud container and the user's device: the egress proxy denies CONNECT (connect_rejected, gateway 502). That is an egress-policy block, unrelated to www.mnd.gov.tw. Reopened and settled in round 7 (2026-08-29) — see the browser-unblock slice for that country and project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29.

The access verdict here was wrong: mnd.gov.tw is fully readable to plain curl with a browser user-agent, including every File/<id> download — 'ROBOTS_DISALLOWED' was WebFetch obeying robots.txt, not the site refusing. The 2025 (114年) National Defense Report was downloaded in both editions (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54548 English, https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54313 Chinese) and this node now carries two minted edges. Reopened and settled in round 7 (2026-08-29) — see the browser-unblock slice for that country and project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29.

Access verdict corrected, and the answer is a genuine negative rather than a block. MND does publish machine-readable defence-industry statistics — https://www.mnd.gov.tw/informationservices/publication/86508 (114年統計資料發布, 主計局, 18 tables) includes 民營廠商承攬重大軍事工程案件統計 (File/57518), 民營廠商承銷重大軍品採購案件統計 (File/57519) and the Armaments Bureau construction tables (File/57516, File/57517), all text-extractable with full 編製說明. But their compilation notes name only internal Armaments Bureau records as the data source (資料來源：軍備局(工程營產處)), which is not a corpus node. Readable, verified, and no edge. Reopened and settled in round 7 (2026-08-29) — see the browser-unblock slice for that country and project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29.

This round found a real, different primary source (CBC's own 2016 paper on BPM6 adoption, discussing sign/classification conventions for reserve assets generally) than the round-2028-08-28 no-document finding, but it explains Taiwan's general BPM6 adoption rather than stating that the published Foreign Exchange Reserves series itself is documented under BPM6 methodology. Per PLAYBOOK rule 14, checked against the existing note before minting: CBC's own SDDS page for international reserves explicitly states 'Documentation on the methodology is not available' -- a specific, on-point denial that outweighs the more general BPM6-adoption paper. Not overridden; the earlier no-document finding stands. (tw-external-debt -> imf-bpm6 is a separate, distinct edge from the same BPM6 paper and is NOT affected -- that paper explicitly discusses the International Investment Position, whose liabilities side underlies external-debt statistics, under BPM6.)

Resolved, and the direction was backwards. mnd.gov.tw was never blocked to plain curl. The 2025 National Defense Report's own source note says its published MND budget figure is derived from the budget — "The MND budget is calculated based on the legal budget in 2024 at an NTD to USD exchange rate of 30.651:1" (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54548; Chinese edition 「國防部預算」係以113年法定預算為列計基礎). The budget-document side was searched for the converse (InformationServices/BudgetandFinalAccounts/c/56011, publication/81919, publication/71877, and the budget statistics tables File/57520 and File/57521 with their 編製說明) and nothing says budget compilation draws on the National Defense Report. The edge is minted the other way as tw-national-defense-report -> tw-defense-budget. Reopened and settled in round 7 (2026-08-29) — see the browser-unblock slice for that country and project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29.
